title: The formation of generous Christlike disciples

body:
Imagine what would happen if for the next five hundred years, our churches put as much energy into the formation of generous, Christlike disciples as we have put into getting people to believe certain things or show up at certain buildings or observe certain taboos or support certain political or economic ideologies or keep certain people gainfully employed.

 – The Great Spiritual Migration (available TODAY)
